review.tagline: Unofficial Python API, CLI and MCP server for Google NotebookLM
review.summary: Drives NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook) through its undocumented web endpoints, with an opt-in Android gRPC backend. It exposes notebooks, sources, cited chat, research agents and artifact generation (audio, video, slides, quizzes, mind maps) via an async Python client, a CLI, an MCP server, a REST server and an installable agent skill. Artifacts download in bulk as MP3, MP4, PDF, PPTX, CSV, JSON or Markdown.
review.audience: Developers scripting NotebookLM or giving coding agents a grounded research tool
strengths: Covers notebooks, sources, chat, notes, research, sharing and all Studio artifact types
Bulk artifact download in MP3, MP4, PDF, PPTX, CSV, JSON and Markdown
Ships CLI, MCP server (stdio or remote), REST server and Claude Code/Codex skill
Master-token auth refreshes sessions unattended for servers and CI
weaknesses: Relies on undocumented Google APIs that can break without notice
Not affiliated with Google; heavy use may be rate limited
Needs a Google account; source counts per notebook depend on account tier
Default login downloads Chromium (~170 MB) via Playwright
needs: Needs Google account, Google NotebookLM / Gemini Notebook, Playwright Chromium (for browser login)
